title: Systemic Trust
hook: That pushy upsell might win you this month. The lost trust costs you the next five years.
statement: Long-term trust beats squeezing customers for short-term money. Every time.
explainer: Trust turns into referrals and repeat business. Break it once and every future sale has to be earned again from scratch.
sop: Write down every promise your business makes, spoken or implied.
Look back 90 days for any time you cut a corner on one.
Rate your Consistency and Integrity honestly, 1 to 10 each.
Write your standards down so trust doesn't depend on mood.
Turn down one short-term grab this month, even if it's easier.
equation_example: Consistency 8, Time 3 years with the customer, Integrity 9. 8 × 3 × 9 = 216. Higher means trust is compounding into referrals and repeat sales. Lower means every sale starts from zero.
question: Write down one place you're tempted to squeeze a customer for a short-term win.
closing_statement: Every shortcut taken today is remembered tomorrow.
caption:
Principle Nº 175: Systemic Trust
